system.description: When wielding only two light melee weapons or two Lightsabers, whenever you make a single attack as a Standard Action with one weapon, you can make a single attack with the other weapon as a Free Action against the same target. You apply the normal penalties for fighting with two weapons with this attack.

prerequisite.text: Dual Weapon Mastery I feat, and Weapon Finesse feat

nodes.text: Dual Weapon Mastery I feat, and Weapon Finesse feat
